launcher.notes: ALWAYS ASKED. The update prompt is now automatic: three redundant sources raced in parallel (quota-free latest.json on raw.githubusercontent + its jsDelivr CDN mirror + the GitHub API with a soft timeout, releases feed as last resort), boot checks retry with backoff (20s/1m/3m/8m/15m) until the first success then re-check every 10 minutes, a found release is REMEMBERED and its prompt replays on every start until the installed version catches up, prompts are only sent once the UI is listening (renderer-ready gate), failed checks are logged with the reason, and Settings > Maintenance gains a Check for launcher updates button. Bundles Kinetrix Client v3.3.8 Mirror.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. The hub now uses the module menu window proportions (no more near-fullscreen). New "Customize Cosmetics" button on the pause screen for in-world/server customization. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.
